effects.name: Marketing Cut
effects.true_mechanism: Paid-search marketing spend reduced by 40% in SP and RJ; traffic follows with a ~2-week lag.
effects.confounder: Category-mix shift in computers_accessories channel spend during the same period.

effects.name: Top-Category Stockouts
effects.true_mechanism: 25% of catalog items in top 3 categories marked out-of-stock (stockout_flag=1), suppressing item volume.
effects.expected_effect_size: Stockout rate 25.0% in peak window, ~12% item volume suppression
effects.confounder: Black-Friday seasonal demand surge in late November (2017-11-24 to 2017-11-27).

effects.name: Promo AOV Dilution
effects.true_mechanism: 20% discount across major categories lifts order count by ~15% while AOV drops by ~12%, GMV remains flat.
effects.confounder: Payment method mix shift toward boleto payment options.

effects.name: Delivery Delay Spike
effects.true_mechanism: Regional logistics congestion for carrier_sul increases transit days by +11, driving SLA breach to 35% with lagged review score drop.
effects.expected_effect_size: Actual delivery days +11, SLA breach rate 35.0%, Review score drop -0.80
effects.confounder: Simultaneous increase in average regional freight costs due to expedited rerouting.

effects.name: Price Elasticity Shift
effects.true_mechanism: +10% list price adjustment results in -15% demand reduction; empirical elasticity = -1.50.
effects.confounder: Competitor price movement (+8%) lagged by 1 week.
